### 1 — Scene
A roast-style dinner: sliced beef, cauliflower, roast potatoes, a browned stuffing-like ball, and a pale creamy side.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
- Sliced roast beef with a little herb garnish
- Cooked cauliflower
- Roast potatoes with visible browned, oily surfaces
- Pale, herb-speckled creamy side, possibly mushrooms or vegetables in sauce
- Browned stuffing-like ball

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
The food covers approximately **87%** of the plate. Oil on the potatoes and sauce on the creamy side are included in their energy densities, not counted twice.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cauliflower | 34% | 181 cm² × 2.8 cm = 507 ml | 0.55 | 280 g | 25 | 70 kcal |
| Roast beef | 20% | 106 cm² × 1.2 cm = 127 ml | 0.98 | 125 g | 250 | 313 kcal |
| Roast potatoes | 14% | 74 cm² × 2.6 cm = 192 ml | 0.65 | 125 g | 150 | 188 kcal |
| Creamy side | 12% | 64 cm² × 1.4 cm = 90 ml | 0.90 | 80 g | 140 | 112 kcal |
| Stuffing-like ball | 7% | 37 cm² × 2.0 cm = 74 ml | 0.90 | 65 g | 220 | 143 kcal |

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 675 g and 825 kcal** is plausible for this substantially covered dinner plate. The cauliflower contributes considerable weight but little energy. The identity of the creamy side and browned ball is the largest uncertainty.
